error_envelope.description: Every error response uses this envelope. The code is stable and machine-matchable; the message is human prose and may change.

freshness.description: Every data response carries this block. Agents must check status before analysis.

status.description: Only 'complete' snapshots are reproducible. Anything else is still being written.

pagination.description: Cursor pagination. A response with next_token set to null is the last page. Clients must never assume a page is last because it is short.

next_token.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when this is the last page.

total.description: Total items across all pages at the time of the request.

authentication.description: Every request authenticates with a read-only API key in the Authorization header. Keys are per-agent and revocable; old keys keep working for seven days after rotation. This definition documents the scheme; it never appears in a response body.

description: Contract for the peira leaderboard API. DESIGN ONLY. The API does not exist yet; when it ships, every response must validate against this schema. Written before the API so agents can rely on the shape from day one.

data.description: The payload. Shape is defined per endpoint.
